summarize_aero_hand_constants: summarize the aero hand constants module that defines joint, actuator, fingertip, and sensor names for the TetherIA Aero Hand Open robot
retrieve_joint_names: retrieve the list of 16 joint names for the right hand fingers and thumb from aero_hand_constants
retrieve_actuator_names: retrieve the list of 7 actuator tendon names for the right hand from aero_hand_constants
get_robot_dimensions: get the robot state dimensions NQ=16, NV=16, and control dimensions NU=7 from aero_hand_constants
locate_scene_xml_path: locate the path to the MJX cube scene XML file for the aero hand manipulation environment
